_README: Optional, vault-specific. Copy this file to forest-config.json (same directory) and edit. Without a forest-config.json, the forest tools fall back to domain=tree identity: each top-level subject domain becomes its own tree. See docs/CONVENTIONS.md § Forest layer.

_schema.domain_to_tree: map of subject top-level domain -> tree name. Domains not listed fall back to identity (the domain becomes its own tree).
_schema.tree_descriptions: map of tree name -> one-line description, shown in the forest dashboard.
_schema.tree_labels: map of tree name -> human display name (e.g. 'ai' -> 'Artificial Intelligence'). naite-app shows this instead of the prettified id; omit a tree to fall back to its prettified id. Abbreviation expansion lives here, never hardcoded in the app.
_schema.neutral_domains: list of domains seeded with NO tree, so link-neighbor label propagation decides their tree. Use for source labels that span lineages.
